jobs.title: Kundenservice & Manufacturing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Probatix Probatix bietet Labordiagnostik als Service an: Unsere Partner – digitale Gesundheitsprogramme, Telemedizin-Anbieter, Health Apps, Krankenversicherungen und Arztpraxen – bieten ihren Kunden Heimtests unter eigener Marke an. Wir liefern alles dahinter: Testkits, Partnerlabore, Logistik, Plattform und Support. Dabei sind wir selbst Hersteller unserer Testkits. Vom Auftrag über die Konfektionierung und den Versand bis zum Befund im Portal bilden wir den gesamten Prozess ab – in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz, mit Standorten in Berlin und Steinhausen (CH). Als Mitarbeiter Kundenservice & Manufacturing arbeitest du direkt mit unserer Head of Operations zusammen und bist an der Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, Partnern und der Kit-Produktion tätig. Deine Aufgaben Kundenservice Du beantwortest Anfragen von Endkunden und Partnern per Chat und E-Mail – zu Testkits, Probenentnahme, Versand und Ergebnisabruf. Du bearbeitest Ersatzkit-Anfragen, Retouren und Reklamationen und dokumentierst sie nach den Vorgaben unseres Qualitätsmanagements. Du erkennst wiederkehrende Probleme, gibst sie an Produkt- und Operations-Team weiter und hältst Help Center und FAQs aktuell. Manufacturing & Fulfillment Du konfektionierst Testkits nach Arbeitsanweisung – Komponenten, Gebrauchsanweisung, Etiketten, Verpackung – und führst die Chargendokumentation, damit jedes Kit rückverfolgbar ist. Du bereitest die Whitelabel-Verpackung unserer Partner vor und sorgst für den termingerechten Versand. Du pflegst die Lagerbestände in unserem Warenwirtschaftssystem, behältst Mindestbestände im Blick und stößt Nachbestellungen von Material rechtzeitig an. Du arbeitest daran mit, unsere Abläufe in Konfektionierung und Versand zu standardisieren und zu vereinfachen. Dein Profil Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium, z. jobs.title: Manager, Case Management (LCSW/LMFT)
jobs.description: Join the dynamic journey at Vynca , where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs. We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day. At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home. About the job Department: Enhanced Care Management (ECM) Internal Title: ECM Clinical Manager The ECM Clinical Manager is responsible for clinical oversight and management of ECM staff to address the client's medical and behavioral health needs and social determinants of health. The ECM Clinical Manager will communicate directly with ECM staff and occasionally with patients via telephone, telehealth, or during Interdisciplinary Care Team meetings (as needed) to discuss medication management/adherence, ensure appropriate follow-up with Primary Care Provider, Behavioral Health Provider, and other specialist(s). They will guide any crises encountered by ECM staff. The ECM Clinical Manager will collaborate with the client’s broader care team (PCP, BH clinicians, etc.) to provide client advocacy, ensure that the clients receive needed services, and measure progress toward the goals outlined in their patient-centered individualized care plan. The ECM Clinical Manager will monitor team progress and coach staff to succeed and manage performance where needed. This a remote role with up to 25% travel. Candidate must be available to work Monday-Friday 8:30am to 5pm Pacific Time with potential evenings/weekends. At this time, we are only considering those based in one of the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, Utah, and Washi

About the job We are seeking a dedicated Lead Care Manager (LCM) to join our team. Reporting to the Director of Enhanced Care Management, ECM Clinical Manager, and/or ECM Program Manager, the LCM serves as the primary coordinator for clients, partnering with healthcare providers, specialists, pharmacists, social service agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless, person-centered care. The LCM manages client cases, coordinates health care benefits, provides education and facilitates member access to care in a timely and cost-effective manner. The LCM collaborates and communicates with client’s caregivers/family support persons, other providers and others in the Care Team in order to promote wellness, recovery, independence, resilience, and member empowerment, while ensuring access to appropriate services and maximizing member benefit. jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Drug Development & Clinical Strategy
jobs.description: Position Summary:  Quotient is seeking a highly analytical and scientifically curious Senior Analyst to support strategic decision-making across our growing drug development pipeline. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of analytics, market intelligence, commercial strategy and early drug development in a genetics-based biotech company.  The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills and familiarity with scientific and clinical data with commercial curiosity, to turn networks of complex data into meaningful insights. In doing so, the successful candidate will help us better understand where high-value, tractable drug development opportunities exist across our internal pipeline of drug targets, and more broadly across a range of disease areas. Together with other members of the drug development team, this role will help focus which indications, patient segments, and development paths we should consider, and where data can help inform our investment and planning decisions. This role could be based in our UK or US office and will report to the Chief Development Officer. jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: People Business Partner As a People Business Partner at myTomorrows, you are a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the Leadership Team. In this Individual contributor People Business Partner role, you will translate business priorities into practical people solutions that enable high performing teams and organizational growth. You will partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands on execution and are comfortable navigating the pace, ambiguity, and opportunities of a fast growing international scale up. jobs.title: Senior Computational Biologist
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology , we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines. What you'll do You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation. Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny. Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality

jobs.title: Clinical Data Systems & Data Management
jobs.description: Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand. As a Clinical Data Systems & Data Management Lead , you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, integrity, security, and accessibility of clinical trial data. You will act as the bridge between Clinical Operations, Data Management, IT, and Quality teams while supporting the deployment, administration, and evolution of clinical research systems. Key Responsibilities Provide methodological and technical support for the design and deployment of clinical data collection tools (eCRF). Administer clinical research systems, including eTMF, CTMS, GED/QMS, TRMS, and other business applications. Manage interfaces and APIs between key clinical systems to ensure seamless data flow. Oversee the storage, archiving, security, and integrity of clinical study databases. Contribute to the definition and deployment of the organization's Data Management strategy. Ensure compliance with GCP, GDPR Participate in SOP development, user training, and support activities. Drive digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives within clinical research operations. Requirements Education Master's degree in Data Science, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Data Management, Life Sciences, or a related field. Experience Significant experience in Clinical Data Management and/or administration of computerized clinical systems. Technical Skills Strong understanding of clinical trial data management processes and clinical research environments. Experience with clinical systems such as eTMF, CTMS, eCRF, GED/QMS, or related platforms. Knowledge of Ennov Clinical and/or REDCap is a plus. Familiarity with SAS, R, SPSS, or other statistical tools is advantageous. Understanding of GCP, GDPR, and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Languages Professional proficiency in English. Benefits Why

jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
